title: pip prior to v26.2.2 the certifi bundled with pip contains the compromised eMudhra certificates. (CVE-2026-133949)
description: pip versions prior to 26.2.2 include a bundled certifi package containing compromised eMudhra certificates. This vulnerability relates to the trust of these compromised certificates, which can affect the security of TLS connections made by pip. The issue is mitigated if pip is used with a Python version that rejects these compromised intermediates (CVE-2026-115557). Users are advised to upgrade pip to version 26.2.2 or later or upgrade Python to a secure version. Alternatively, hash pinning a known-secure pip version can mitigate the risk.
